hardware_context.source: npu-arch typical DAV_3510 reference, not runtime-measured

work_ops.note: Exp/Div are proxy operations; not true FLOPs

diagnoses.problem: AIV core parallelism is severely underused

metrics.name: aiv_core_coverage
metrics.supports: parallel coverage is low against DAV_3510 AIV denominator

metrics.name: output_elements_per_active_core
metrics.supports: all elements are assigned to one active core

diagnoses.roofline_interpretation: Whole-device throughput is capped by blockDim=1 even if the active core is efficient; true utilization requires real Task Duration and hardware counters.
diagnoses.recommendation: Make blockDim shape-aware and distribute work across available AIV cores when the shape is large enough.

diagnoses.problem: Tile pipeline is mostly serialized by barriers and non-overlapped copy/compute

metrics.name: barriers_per_tile_source
metrics.value: at least 5 PipeBarrier calls on the normal tile path
metrics.supports: copy, vector math, and output are serialized by barriers

metrics.name: tile_num
metrics.supports: both tiles follow the same serial copy/compute/copy path

metrics.name: load_store_move_like_duration
metrics.supports: load/store/move-like simulator events dominate the trace proxy

metrics.name: RV_SMEM_BAR_duration
metrics.supports: sync exists, but real wait ratio is unavailable

diagnoses.roofline_interpretation: Trace proxy suggests copy/scheduling overhead is significant, but real MTE/VEC bound and overlap rate need PipeUtilization.csv or Memory.csv.
diagnoses.recommendation: Use queue/double-buffer style overlap where applicable and reduce full-pipeline barriers on the hot tile path.

confidence_notes: No baseline, variant name, inject manifest, label alignment report, or ground-truth label was used.
Parallelism diagnosis is high confidence from tiling and hardware denominator.
Pipeline/data-movement diagnosis is medium confidence because evidence is simulator trace proxy only.
Roofline is estimated/proxy, not a direct hardware utilization measurement.
